Description from DeviantArt Account:
"This comic was written as an experiment to explore a Hitchcockian method of story telling. Lots of setup and rising tension until the Climax where, if I've done it right, you forget where you are or what is going on around you and your desperate to find out what is on the next page.

I hope this project offers you that. Fare warning it is a little rough in spots, by design, so that you have nothing but contempt for the villain and nothing but sympathy for his victims.

If I can't offer you this experience (and I'm full aware some of you wont be swayed by anything in this story) then I hope that you can find something else in it that will make reading this comic worth of your time. Thank you."
